sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: latest financial anchor used in packet

financial_anchor.caveat: S$11.4bn net profit with approximately 18% ROE; measure may be adjusted or a labelled scale proxy and is not normalized.

ai_claim.claim: DBS Group describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in fraud and scam detection over transaction networks, credit and risk decision support using repayment outcomes.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: fraud loss per transaction, vintage default at fixed approval mix, service resolution cost, CET1 and risk-adjusted return
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: OCBC and digital banks and payment platforms can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Bank secrecy, consent and purpose limitation constrain account data. Customer-specific inference may be permissible for service/risk, while unrestricted pooled generative training is not established.
materiality_summary: Five percent of the completed-year earnings anchor is S$550m; no AI-attributed amount is established.

arithmetic.result: S$550m annual hurdle; no AI-attributed cash result.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
